The optional Attention card
01

Record your day

Capture conversations, ideas and plans with your iPhone’s microphone, or clip on the optional Attention card and leave your phone in your pocket. Attention recognizes your voice and keeps only what you said — other people’s voices are discarded after transcription.

  • iPhone mic or the Attention card
  • Only your own voice is kept
  • Searchable notes and summaries
02

Daily Attention Score

One number for how much attention headroom you had today, measured against your own baseline — not against anyone else. See what drained you, what restored you, and how the week is trending.

The score is a personal reflection tool. It is an estimate of your day’s load, not medical advice.

03

Your agent does the work

Ask in chat, or just mention it in passing. Your agent drafts the email, finds the table, fills the form and keeps track of what’s next.

ChatAsk anything about your day, your notes or your inbox, and get it done.
Cloud browserYour agent works on real websites in a secure cloud browser and stops for your approval before anything is submitted, paid for or sent.
Open-in-app cardsFor DoorDash, OpenTable, Google Maps, Venmo and more, the agent sets it up and hands you a card — you finish in that app.
04

Connect everything

Bring your agent the context it needs, on your terms. Connect as many Gmail and Google Calendar accounts as you like, the specific Google Drive files you choose, Notion and more. Disconnect any of them at any time.

GmailGoogle CalendarGoogle DriveNotionCalendlyMore soon
05

Second You

An assistant that grows into you, one level at a time — and only as far as you let it.

  1. L1 · StyleWrites the way you do.
  2. L2 · MemoryRemembers people, plans and preferences.
  3. L3 · AssistantProposes the next step and prepares it.
  4. L4 · DelegateHandles routine tasks on your behalf. Coming soon.

Privacy, in plain words

  • We keep only your own voice. Recordings that include other people are deleted after transcription.
  • We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.
  • Nothing is sent, submitted, booked or paid for on your behalf without your explicit approval.
  • Connected accounts are optional, use only the permissions you grant, and can be disconnected at any time.
  • You can delete your account and all of your data from inside the app.

Attention’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
